notes.title: Important Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings, Wanderers!

Recently a major update was released for my new Hero's Story game, which is still in development, in which a new game zone and a lot of content were added. But what kind of game is this, and how does it relate to Wanderer of Teandria?

ONE UNIVERSE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25154850/de21a3d3c686035d2da36fdd944fbbd7c403bd50.png

Hero's Story takes place approximately 300 years after the end of the events of Wanderer of Teandria. In the center of events is a young mercenary of one of the states of Teandria, who got into trouble. In Hero's Story, you will have the opportunity to look at the world of Teandria in three dimensions!

WANDERER'S STORY

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25154850/a742448e8757982f06be18fcd1f6012ff6d72edf.png

Hero's Story has a lot of books, notes and in-game references. You will be able to personally meet the matured Ludvig van Carsten, learn more about the history of wanderers and explore battlefields seen in Wanderer of Teandria.

NEW LEVEL

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25154850/1e12e24dcf6ee29dbf04aa8ca1cda8945c8739a6.png

New game is the largest game in the series. Modern graphics, lots of game mechanics and a wide variety of content - that's what awaits you in Hero's Story. The full release of the game is scheduled for Q2 2024.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/649970/Heros_Story/

That's it for today! Sincerely yours, Silentplaygames.

notes.title: About Key Revocation
notes.content:
Hello Wanderers!

Recently i've got few messages from people who they say bought the game on Groupees website in December of 2015 and haven't activated their keys yet. It was in March of 2019.
They stated that when they finally got to activate the game on Steam - their key was revoked. But why? Let me explain.

There are so called gray markets in the Internet like G2A. They often sell games cheaper than Steam. So what's the catch? Catch is that these keys are not legal and may be revoked at any time! In my case it was the fact that i don't cooperate with all of these sites (except Groupees).
Someone just bought the keys on cheaper price and reselled it. Which is, of course, against the rules!
Sadly I did not immediately notice the suspicious activity in Wanderer of Teandria keys activation and there were some keys that were activated illegally.
So i decided to revoke all of the UNUSED keys of the game for several reasons:

- All who bought the game on Groupees should've activate it from 2016
- I have no other instrument except key revocation to prevent resells of my work
- I've revoked only unused keys (not in the player's library) so all who played the game/gained achievement etc was not affected
- I can't divide keys which were bought fair or not

I am very sad about the fact that i had to do that and that i didn't make the announcement erlier but i guess it's better sooner or later.
I've replied all of the customers via support email and hope that you understand my situation.

Take care, Silentplaygames.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25154850/d2478432902868b2a40850e3506bddc8270920df.jpg

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Hello fellow Wanderers! Today i've released an update for Wanderer of Teandria. Patch 1.1 is one of the biggest updates for the game since Early Access.

It contains new levels, bugfixes, updated launcher, 100% working achievements, updated sprites and more.
Full list of changes lies below. I hope you will like this version!

Cheers, Silentplaygames.

 Update 1.1 "Ghosts of the Future" 

   Fifth game zone with few additional levels was added
  Pause after player's death was added (request)
  Game Launcher was updated for improved stability
  Game interface now will properly hide when Zoom is activated (L/LT)
  Now all of the players should be able to obtain Hero achievement properly
   Some graphic elements of the game were updated (for example, sprites of the enemies)
   Game resolution in Zoom Mode (L/LT) was updated 
   Fixed graphic bug, when the sword of the player was mirrored while attacking
   Fixed graphic bug with non disappearing effects of projectiles of Shadow and Ancient Golem
   Fixed bug, when bee's sounds were not played after the pause
   Fixed bug, when music of the third boss was playing faster then it should
 Fixed bug, when player can select different menu items while pop up window was active
   Fixed bug with lack of few particle systems when few same objects were on screen
  Fixed rare game bug with possibility to gain "infinite" life
   Balance: Amount of points, which player will gain after Ancien Golem defeat, was reduced from 1500 to 1000
  Balance: Player's magic attack radius was increased from 150 to 170
  Balance: Ancient Golem's health was increased from 1000 to 1200
   Balance: amount of lives was increased by 1 (crystals now give additional lives)
   Unnecessary files were removed
   Russian localization of the game was updated
   Minor changes


You may need to reinstall the game to see some changes. Your savegame will be saved.

notes.title: Testing Branch Updated!
notes.content:
Wanderers! 
Today test version of big update 1.1 for the game was pushed to the Steam servers!
It includes ALL of the bugfixes planned for this update and even some updated graphic elements. New content is not included though.
Fixed inability to gain "Hero" achievement. Fixed many graphic and sound bugs. Zoom in feature (L/LT) now works properly.
You can play test version of the game by right clicking the game or software on your Steam Library and choosing "Properties", from the properties window select the tab titled "Betas". From this page select "-beta" from the drop-down menu.
Full version of the 1.1 update "Ghosts of the Future" is planned to release within a month!
Your sincerely, Silentplaygames.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello fellow Wanderers!

Today i've uploaded new version of the game. 
I am not good at descriptions so here is patch 1.0.1 notes:
- New bonus level with mini-boss added 
- Fixed bug with incorrect time zone after loading game
- Fixed descriptions of some achievements
- Fixed critical bug, when player was able to broke save file with 1 life
- Balance: now, if you had less than 3 lives after boss fight, you will always have 3 lives
- Balance: change rules for bonus levels - now you always have to turn levers or gain more points to open red portals on some levels
- Now players should obtain Treasure Hunter IV achievement correctly
- Unnecessary files were removed
- Minor fixes

Please share your feedback in the comments and discussions.
Have fun, Silentplaygames
